hook_candidates.headline: Stop juggling apps for client projects
Your inbox isn't your task list
Task management isn't optional
hook_candidates.sub: It's built into ChatGPT iOS now

caption:
ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.188 added task management features—no more switching apps to track client projects.

When a client sends a proposal request, instead of opening Trello or Notes, you can now create tasks directly in ChatGPT. Just click the task icon in the chat, type the project name, and add details. The task appears in your chat history, so you never lose track of next steps.

Here's the copy-paste prompt to automate this:

"Create a task for [Client Name]'s [Project Name] with these details: [Summary of what they need]. Include a deadline of [Date]."

Save this workflow. Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.
